title: Fix Sticking and Squeaking Power and Open Buttons on Sony PlayStation One
summary: Fix squeaking and sticking PlayStation One power and open buttons by opening the shell, removing the buttons and lid slider, lubricating all plastic rub points with silicone grease, and reassembling.
warnings: Small springs can spring out and get lost
Use only plastic-safe silicone grease in thin layer

steps.title: Separate the upper shell
steps.instruction: Lift off the upper shell and set aside the lower half to work on the buttons.

evidence.text: first things first you need to remove these six screws on the bottom of the chassis
hands lift upper shell and set aside lower half

steps.title: Unclip the power button
steps.instruction: Gently press the plastic clips on the power button and pop it out the bottom.
warnings: Plastic clips are fragile and can snap if forced

evidence.text: the power button is actually very easy all you need to do to get this out is just press these gently these plastic clips and it pops out the bottom

steps.title: Inspect power button wear
steps.instruction: Inspect the power button spring, clips, and center post for rub marks and dust.

evidence.text: we just have a spring we have these plastic clips that hold it in and the center section here which kind of acts as a centering piece for the spring

steps.title: Lubricate power button
steps.instruction: Apply a very thin layer of silicone grease to the power button rub areas with your finger.
warnings: Use only plastic-safe silicone grease, use very thin layer

evidence.text: I'm going to take silicone grease this is made by Danco 88693
we're going to take just a really small amount and we're going to apply it to the rub areas

steps.title: Refit power button spring
steps.instruction: Lubricate the spring contact lightly and place the spring back on the center post in the correct direction.
warnings: Small spring can fall and get lost

evidence.text: you can apply some of the silicone grease to this too
and then take the spring put it back on and make sure it faces the correct direction

steps.title: Reinsert power button
steps.instruction: Pop the power button back into the shell in the correct orientation.

evidence.text: and then pop that guy right back in

steps.title: Unscrew slider assembly
steps.instruction: Remove the two Phillips screws holding the open-button slider assembly.
steps.fastener_where: two holes on slider mounting bracket
warnings: Hold assembly so spring does not fly when screws release

evidence.text: we're going to take our Phillips head screwdriver take out these two screws

steps.title: Remove slider assembly
steps.instruction: Pull the spring-loaded slider assembly straight out of the shell.
warnings: Small slider spring can detach unexpectedly

evidence.text: and this assembly just pulls out just like that
when you press the button it actually pushes this slider against a spring

steps.title: Lubricate slider contacts
steps.instruction: Rub silicone grease into all plastic-on-plastic contact and wear areas of the slider.
warnings: Do not lose the detached slider spring

evidence.text: we're going to go ahead and just apply some silicone grease in here just rub this into all of the contact areas
you can completely disconnect the spring too if that makes it a little easier to get in there

steps.title: Remove open button
steps.instruction: Pop the open button out of the shell.
warnings: Do not bend the thin plastic clips

evidence.text: and lastly we will pop out the open button and do the exact same thing as we did the power button

steps.title: Lubricate open button
steps.instruction: Apply a very thin layer of silicone grease to the open button contact areas, slide area, and shaft.
warnings: Excess grease attracts dust and causes sticking

evidence.text: we are going to put a little bit of silicone right in here in these contact areas
and lastly right here this is a slide area as well
anywhere that two pieces of plastic rub together that's what you want to get the silicone grease on

steps.title: Reinsert open button
steps.instruction: Pop the open button back in facing the right direction.

evidence.text: so let's go ahead and pop this back in
make sure it faces the right direction of course

steps.title: Reinstall slider assembly
steps.instruction: Put the slider spring back on and reinsert the slider assembly into position.
warnings: Ensure spring hook is seated before releasing

evidence.text: put our spring back on and reinsert this back where it needs to go just like that

steps.title: Screw in slider assembly
steps.instruction: Hold the assembly down, seat each screw counterclockwise until it clicks, then tighten both screws.
steps.fastener_where: two holes on slider mounting bracket
warnings: Do not overtighten screws in plastic posts

evidence.text: now you're going to want to hold that down with a finger or two while you grab the hardware
make sure you turn this counterclockwise gently counterclockwise until you hear a little bit of a click

steps.title: Test the buttons
steps.instruction: Flip the shell over and press the power and open buttons to verify smooth return.

evidence.text: now we can go ahead and turn that over and give these buttons a test
much better
fingers press power and open buttons smoothly
